name: Bike repair

pf.license.business: No trade license for bike repair. Business registration where the state's form asks for it; identity checked; 'license: what the business says'.
pf.license.person: None. E-bike motor and battery work only by staff with the maker's service training (a skill set at S2-15, not a license).
pf.license.insurance: The business's own liability insurance; Rosie doesn't check it.

pf.services.name: Flat fix
pf.services.example: $20 plus the tube (the example shop's own price)
pf.services.length: 30 minutes; drop-off ready the same day
pf.services.where: A: drop-off at the shop, or wait at the counter. B: at the customer's place
pf.services.money: A: nothing up front, paid at pick-up. B: card saved, charged at DONE

pf.services.name: Basic tune-up
pf.services.example: $89 at the shop, $119 by the van
pf.services.length: A: drop-off, ready in 2 to 3 days. B: about 1 hour at the van
pf.services.money: A: nothing up front, paid at pick-up. B: card saved, charged at DONE

pf.services.name: Repair priced after a look (brakes, gears, wheel true, e-bike check)
pf.services.example: labor and parts quoted after the mechanic looks; nothing done before the customer's yes
pf.services.length: A: drop-off, ready date given with the quote. B: on the spot when the van carries the parts
pf.services.money: A: nothing up front, paid at pick-up. B: card saved, charged at DONE

pf.services.name: Wheel build or special-order part
pf.services.example: $380, with the $180 parts cost paid up front as the deposit and $200 at pick-up
pf.services.length: drop-off, ready about 7 to 10 days after the part comes
pf.services.money: A: deposit when booking (the parts cost), the rest at pick-up

pf.services.name: Bike fit
pf.services.example: $175, 90 minutes with the named fitter, the rider stays
pf.services.money: A: card saved for a $50 late-cancel fee inside 24 hours, paid at the counter

pf.services.name: New bike assembly
pf.services.money: A: nothing up front, paid at pick-up

pf.questions.before_times: The kind of bike (road, mountain, kids', e-bike, cargo); what's wrong, in a few words (picks the service and the time); for an e-bike, the motor's maker (who may work on it). Flow B: where the bike will be (a driveway, garage or office lot) and where the van can park.
pf.questions.secure_page_only: Nothing (no health or money details are asked).
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult. A parent or guardian books for a child's bike.

pf.safety.stop_words: An e-bike battery that is swollen, hot, smoking, hissing, smells of burning, or was in water or a fire. Brakes that don't work, or a cracked frame or fork. A crash with someone hurt.
pf.safety.what_rosie_says: Battery: 'Don't charge it or bring it inside. Keep it outside, away from anything that burns. If it's smoking or on fire, call 911.' Brakes or frame: 'Please don't ride it. Walk it in or bring it by car.' Someone hurt: 911 first.
pf.safety.booking_goes_on: Yes after the battery or brakes steps (safety steps, then go on); no booking during a fire or an injury (911).

pf.first_steps.prep: Bring the bike clean enough to work on. E-bikes: bring the battery key and the charger. Take off bags, lights or child seats you want to keep.

pf.visit.A: Drop-off at the counter: the code checks the bike in; the mechanic notes the bike's state (scratches, missing parts) in front of the customer; a repair is quoted before any work. Extra parts found during the work (a worn chain, a cracked tire) are quoted first and done only on the customer's own yes. A READY text with the pick-up hours; pick-up with the code or an ID; paid at pick-up. A bike fit: the rider stays; the code at the desk.
pf.visit.B: The van parks at the customer's place at a set arrival window; the customer, or someone they name, hands over the bike; the tech works in the van; extra parts quoted first; DONE when the bike is handed back; the saved card is charged then.
pf.visit.done_proof: A: the pick-up (code or ID). B: DONE from the tech.

pf.money.ways: Most work: nothing up front, paid at pick-up. Special-order parts: the parts cost as a deposit. Bike fit: a card saved for the late-cancel fee. Mobile van: a card saved, charged at DONE.
pf.money.fees: Bike fit: $50 inside 24 hours. Van visit: a $35 trip fee inside 24 hours or nobody there. Drop-off repairs: no fee.
pf.money.tax: Tax on parts where the state's rules require it (the business's own setting).
pf.money.rosfield: $2 per booking (not a health practice or a law firm).

pf.messages.never_in_text: Nothing beyond the master's rules (no health or money details).

pf.staff.skills: Any mechanic does standard work; e-bike motor and battery work only by trained staff; fits only by the named fitter; the van tech works alone (an emergency contact is required).
pf.staff.who_oks: The owner OKs quotes over the shop's limit.
pf.staff.stand_in: Drop-off work: any mechanic with the skill (the customer books the shop, not a person). A bike fit names the fitter: never moved to someone else on silence.

pf.rules.unclaimed: The owner's not-picked-up rule, as plain text (example: a storage fee from 14 days after READY; after the period the state's rules set for unclaimed items, the shop follows those rules).
pf.rules.records: Work orders kept as the master keeps records.

pf.edges.extra parts found: quoted first; the customer's own yes (A8-85 / B8-96)
pf.edges.a part on back-order after drop-off: the ready date moves; the customer is told (A8-11)

New build (H3, Tue Oct 27 2026) on the frozen master: from repair-shop (refitted), base plug-in = the verified test-drive work/testdrive/bike-repair.md (facts, services, prices, rules and the decided fixes kept).
Flow A, the shop: drop-off tune-up $89 (nothing taken, paid at pick-up); flat fix $20 plus the tube; a repair priced after a look (nothing done before the customer's yes); wheel build $380 with the $180 parts deposit, $200 at pick-up; bike fit $175 with the named fitter, a card saved for the $50 late-cancel fee.

Facts: dropoff, extrawork. Switches: none ($2 applies, D97). Settings: A set start, B 2-hour window, B cutoff 24 hours before.
No trade license (D96): registration only, nothing is looked up. E-bike motor and battery work only by trained staff (a skill).
Plans, packs, memberships, insurance, staged bills and sent-now are off: a bike shop sells none of them.
Renames: names, addresses, the shop and van names, and every example price and service in the master text moved to bike words. Chain cleaning is not a service here.
